title: Terms of Use
html:
These terms cover the Country Flags app for iOS. By using the app you accept them. If you do not, do not use the app.

What the app is

Country Flags teaches the flags of the world by spaced repetition: you are shown a flag, you say whether you knew it, and the app decides when to ask again. Most of it is free. Some decks are sold separately as a one-time purchase. There are no subscriptions, and the app shows no advertising.

Accounts

An account is optional — everything works without one. If you create an account with Apple or Google, keep control of that provider account: anyone who can sign in with it can reach your progress. You may delete your account at any time from the account screen, which erases your data immediately.
